_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: search_index
data.create_virtual_stmt: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE "search_index" USING fts5(kind UNINDEXED, target_id UNINDEXED, thread_id UNINDEXED, channel_id UNINDEXED, space_id UNINDEXED, body, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2')

sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_index" USING fts5(kind UNINDEXED, target_id UNINDEXED, thread_id UNINDEXED, channel_id UNINDEXED, space_id UNINDEXED, body, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_operator_agent_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NULL, "capabilities" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_space_states" ("space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("collapsed" IN (0, 1)), "sort_key" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("space_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "topic" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_operator_agent_id" TEXT NULL, "forum_default_sort" TEXT NULL, "default_notification_level" TEXT NULL, "read_only" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("read_only" IN (0, 1)), "main_thread_id" TEXT NULL, "dm_participant_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "settings_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NULL, "capabilities" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channel_operators" ("channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operator_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "operator_agent_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("channel_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "forum_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "restricted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("restricted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "threads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_message_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "title_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "closed_by" TEXT NULL, "operator_agent_id" TEXT NULL, "billing_mode" TEXT NULL, "last_message_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unread_floor_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_activity_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "moved_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_accessed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "thread_tags" ("thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("thread_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "author_principal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_msg_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_code" TEXT NULL, "content_md" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_format" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_truncated" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("content_truncated" IN (0, 1)), "reply_to_message_id" TEXT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NULL, "trigger_state" TEXT NULL, "trigger_state_reason" TEXT NULL, "trigger_state_at" TEXT NULL, "silent" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("silent" IN (0, 1)), "mention_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "edited_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reactions_summary" ("message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "emoji" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "me" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("me" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("message_id", "emoji"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "my_mentions" ("message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "principal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_id", "principal_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "message_components" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "single_use" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("single_use" IN (0, 1)), "required_capability" TEXT NULL, "restricted_to" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NULL, "used_by" TEXT NULL, "used_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "uploaded_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_channel_id" TEXT NULL, "upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "scan_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "transcript_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "transcript_language" TEXT NULL, "transcript_source" TEXT NULL, "thumbnails" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "message_attachments" ("message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_id", "file_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "agent_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "triggered_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "state_reason" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "billing_mode_expected" TEXT NOT NULL, "billing_mode_used" TEXT NULL, "status_line" TEXT NULL, "summary" TEXT NULL, "cost_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "cost_is_estimate" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("cost_is_estimate" IN (0, 1)), "step_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "queued_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agents" ("principal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "handle" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_file_id" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "billing_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "tool_class" TEXT NOT NULL, "reported_runtime_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "reported_billing_mode" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("principal_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "principals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "handle" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_file_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commands" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_principal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_id" TEXT NULL, "options" TEXT NOT NULL, "required_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "control" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("control" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "read_states" ("thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_read_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mention_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unread_count" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("thread_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drafts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_md" TEXT NOT NULL, "reply_to_message_id" TEXT NULL, "file_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_preferences" ("target_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "muted_until" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("target_kind", "target_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quiet_hours" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_local" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_local" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instance" ("instance_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "accent_color" TEXT NULL, "logo_file_id" TEXT NULL, "branding_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "locale_default" TEXT NOT NULL, "spec_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "features" TEXT NOT NULL, "limits" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("instance_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NULL, "depends_on" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_version" INTEGER NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "last_error_reason" TEXT NULL, "conflict_current" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state_changed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "cursor" INTEGER NULL, "sync_epoch" TEXT NULL, "head_seq" INTEGER NULL, "permission_version" INTEGER NULL, "gateway_session_id" TEXT NULL, "disconnected_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_snapshot_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loaded_ranges" ("thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("thread_id", "from_seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_cache" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_accessed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id", "variant"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "share_inbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_thread_id" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_paths" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX channels_space ON channels (space_id)
CREATE INDEX forum_tags_channel ON forum_tags (channel_id)
CREATE INDEX threads_channel ON threads (channel_id)
CREATE INDEX threads_last_accessed ON threads (last_accessed_at)
CREATE INDEX messages_thread_seq ON messages (thread_id, thread_seq)
CREATE INDEX my_mentions_thread ON my_mentions (thread_id)
CREATE INDEX message_components_message ON message_components (message_id)
CREATE INDEX message_attachments_file ON message_attachments (file_id)
CREATE INDEX runs_thread ON runs (thread_id)
CREATE INDEX read_states_channel ON read_states (channel_id)
CREATE INDEX drafts_channel ON drafts (channel_id)
CREATE INDEX outbox_thread_created ON outbox (thread_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX file_cache_last_accessed ON file_cache (last_accessed_at)
